title: Crimean Tatar
summary: Crimean Tatar refers to both an ethnic group and a language associated with the Crimean Tatars, who are a significant minority [[coal-in-ukraine|in Ukraine]], particularly in the Crimean Peninsula.

sections.heading: Crimean Tatars
paragraphs: The [[crimean-tatars|Crimean Tatars]] are an ethnic group native to [[crimea|Crimea]], with a rich cultural heritage and a history that is closely tied to [[administrative-territorial-entity-of-ukraine|the region of Ukraine]]. They have faced various challenges throughout history, including periods of repression and forced displacement.

sections.heading: Crimean Tatar Language
paragraphs: The Crimean Tatar language is the language spoken by the Crimean Tatars. It is a Turkic language that holds cultural significance for the community and is an important aspect of their identity within [[ukraine|Ukraine]].
